requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements for the paired rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors) set out in the preceding paragraphs shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle drawings and the installed vehicle. Measure the lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane, and compare their mounting heights, colours and photometric characteristics. Pass if any deviation from the paired-lamp requirements is limited to what the vehicle's asymmetrical external shape makes unavoidable.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled for each function.
requirements.test_case: Installation and conformity review of the lamp on the M1 vehicle against the individual requirements of each function (colour, mounting position, orientation, geometric visibility angles, electrical connection). Pass: every function meets its own requirements while grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function individually with all other functions of the module switched OFF. Pass: luminous intensities meet the values prescribed for that function.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp (and any other reciprocally incorporated function) with the rear position lamp simultaneously switched ON. Pass: colour of each such function remains within its prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, it shall be installed in such a way that either (a) the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Geometric evaluation (CAD projection or measurement) of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the outer lens. Pass: projected area of distinct parts ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or minimum gap between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: If the lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.; two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body and/or having a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Review of lamp classification and geometric evaluation per paragraph 5.7.2.1. (60 % area or 75 mm gap criterion). Pass: criterion met and the lamp is not declared/approved as an interdependent lamp system on the basis of separate surfaces in a common housing/outer lens.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level check according to paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, Annex 4). Pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of the vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp of the rear combination lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Geometric or visual check on the vehicle per Annex 4: observer moved throughout Zone 1 in the transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle. Pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamp is switched ON and OFF only simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps (if they exist), the side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp, except while one or more of the conditions of paragraph 5.11.1 exist (position lamps switched ON as parking lamps; side-marker lamps flashing with direction indicators; daytime running lamps switched ON; front position lamp function substituted under paragraph 5.12.1).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch circuit: operate the position lamp switch and verify that the rear position lamps, front position lamps, end-outline marker lamps, side-marker lamps (if fitted) and rear registration plate lamp all turn ON and OFF together. Repeat with parking lamps, DRL and paragraph 5.12.1 substitution active to confirm only the permitted exceptions occur. Pass: no state in which any of these lamps can be switched ON or OFF independently outside the 5.11.1 exceptions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the retro-reflected light under the standard illuminant according to the retro-reflector colour test procedure; pass if the coordinates lie within the red chromaticity area defined in the Regulation's colour definitions.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear position lamps fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear position lamps (para. 6.10.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the M1 vehicle installation: count rear non-triangular retro-reflectors fitted and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specification for rear retro-reflectors (para. 6.14.2); pass if equal.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position (locked or not) other than the normal position of use; determine the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis that remains unobscured. Pass: no more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Move the movable component to each fixed position where more than 50 per cent of the rear position lamp apparent surface is hidden; verify the additional lamps switch ON automatically and verify by inspection/measurement that they meet the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps. Pass: additional lamps ON and compliant.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, even bearing an approval mark, is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; the rear position lamp shall therefore be operable by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp as installed on the M1 vehicle: with only the light source and/or fuse fitted (no additional wiring, modules or modifications), switch on the rear position lamp function; pass if the lamp operates.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp; verify replacement function emits red light within the rear position lamp colour boundaries (R48 / R148 colorimetric requirements). Pass: colour similar (red).

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With replacement active, actuate the replacement device's original function (e.g. braking). Pass: original function operates and meets its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure with replacement active. Pass: dashboard tell-tale illuminates indicating temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 have variable luminous intensity control, they shall respond simultaneously only to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.
requirements.test_case: Review the control strategy and inputs, then trigger each listed environmental and traffic condition. Pass if both lamps respond simultaneously and only to the conditions in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, their intensities shall all vary together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of both functions at several control levels across the full range. Pass if both vary together in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, and if the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) has, according to its type approval documentation, been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the lamp shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as it has been approved. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition as specified by the applicant, measure the voltage at the lamp terminals for each function; pass if the voltage does not exceed the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., for 6 Volt-Systems, the voltage at the terminals of the rear position, stop and reversing lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent, when the vehicle electrical system is in a constant voltage operating condition. This does not apply if the device includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each function on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition; pass if ≤ 6.75 V + 3 per cent.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is installed on the vehicle, there shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp to the propagation of light from any part of its apparent surface observed from infinity; obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved are not taken into account.
requirements.test_case: Installed-vehicle inspection: observe the apparent surface from infinity (or parallel-shifted directions) over the full geometric visibility angles prescribed for the rear position lamp; pass if no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the rear combination lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of a lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed (partially masked) unit or with representative masking; pass if the unmasked part meets all photometric values prescribed for approval of each function.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1.; if below 750 mm and reduction to 5° is applicable, verify photometry of installed unit over field down to 5° below horizontal; pass if prescribed values met in that reduced field.

requirements.text: If an LED module of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop or reversing function) is not replaceable, this shall be stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED module shall be replaceable.
requirements.test_case: Document and design review: compare the replaceability of each LED module in the lamp (removal without destroying the lamp) against the component type approval communication sheet (UN R7/R23 or R148). Pass if each non-replaceable LED module is declared non-replaceable on the communication sheet, or if the module is replaceable.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, the rear position lamp function shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check: verify a valid device type approval (UN R148 approval mark for rear position lamp, category R/R1/R2) is held and marked on the lamp before vehicle installation; pass if approval exists and matches the installed device.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo in the light-emitting surface; if present, verify the UN R148 approval covers the logo configuration; pass if approval to UN R148 including the logo exists.

requirements.text: A reversing lamp shall be mandatorily installed on motor vehicles (including category M1).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp function is fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down relative to reference axis; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse gear with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion control to off; also attempt activation with either condition unmet; pass if lamp is OFF in all cases.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check R23/R148 requirements for failure indication; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify tell-tale operates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 shall be installed on the M1 category vehicle (mandatory).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps, handed unit plus mirrored opposite-side unit. Pass if exactly two are installed.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of an S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle, according to R48 para. 5.8 methods, the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be positioned not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground with the vehicle unladen, per para. 5.8.1. Pass if the lowest edge is ≥ 350 mm and the highest edge is ≤ 1,500 mm, or ≤ 2,100 mm where the bodywork justifies it.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation. Pass if the lamp is mounted at the vehicle rear.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle per R48 para. 2.13 and 5.10. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° outward and 45° inward, or 20° inward under the H plane where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed 15° up and 15° down, or 5° down where the mounting height is < 750 mm.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: apply the brake signal and observe all stop lamps, including the S3/S4 lamp. Pass if all illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatorily installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the rear combination lamp contains a rear position lamp function approved as category R, R1 or R2 (approval marking check). Pass if present on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Two rear position lamps shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the rear position lamps fitted (left-hand unit and mirrored right-hand unit). Pass if exactly two mandatory rear position lamps are installed.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the approval mark on the lamp references UN R7 02 or later series, or UN R148 00 or later series. Pass if a valid approval exists.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Installation measurement on the vehicle: measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (in the direction of the reference axis) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. Pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Installation measurement with vehicle on substantially horizontal ground, measured according to paragraph 5.8.1: pass if the height is ≥ 350 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape makes 1,500 mm impossible and no optional lamps are fitted).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear combination lamp with the rear position lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if located at the vehicle rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards (inward angle 20° under the H plane permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if the visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, verify that a rear side-marker lamp is installed and that the apparent surface is visible over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if both conditions are met.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall cover a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify view of the apparent surface 15° above and below the horizontal (downward 5° permitted if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if met.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: At each direction within the alternative visibility angles, determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp, subtracting non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area. Pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² in every direction.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards as installed. Pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory, except when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle function test: switch on rear position lamps with DRL off and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates. Pass if tell-tale indicates switching ON.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify a single combined tell-tale operates for front and rear position lamps. Pass if combined.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component Regulation (UN R7/R148) approval conditions; if failure indication required, simulate LED/light source failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates. Pass if activated.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify a non-triangular rear retro-reflector is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count mandatory rear non-triangular retro-reflectors (one per handed unit); pass if exactly two mandatory devices.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate of the retro-reflector: pass if Class IA or IB per UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Visual and photometric assessment on the vehicle: pass if any additional retro-reflecting device or material does not impair the mandatory rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle (unladen, ground substantially horizontal) the height of the lowest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the highest point of the illuminating surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,200 mm (grouped with rear lamps in the combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm with bodywork-shape justification.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle or CAD: verify the illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards; pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify unobstructed visibility 10° upwards and 10° downwards (5° downwards if mounting height < 750 mm per para. 5.8.1.); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: Red light from the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall not be directly visible to the eye of an observer moving within zone 1, in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.). Zone 1 is bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Visibility check per Annex 4 with the lamp installed on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Explore zone 1 in front of the vehicle between eye heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp, including its illuminated surface or reflections, is directly visible from any point in the zone.

requirements.text: For verifying that red light is not visible to the front, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes. Each plane forms an angle of 15° outwards to the front from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. Each plane passes through the point of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width. If there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric or CAD sightline analysis per Annex 4. Construct 15° outward vertical planes through the foremost overall-width contact points and, from the zone 1 envelope (1 m to 2.2 m height) bounded by these planes, check sightlines to the lamp's red light-emitting surfaces. Pass if no red light-emitting surface is directly visible.

requirements.text: An approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every rear combination lamp ESA conforming to a type approved under UN Regulation No. 10; no such marking is required if the lamp's electrical/electronic system is built into a vehicle approved as a unit.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of production samples of the ESA-approved lamp: verify an approval mark per paragraph 5.3. is affixed. Pass if the mark is present on every unit; not applicable if the lamp is approved only as part of a vehicle type.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA and its electrical/electronic system(s), including its LED light sources, PCB and electrical connections, shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of UN Regulation No. 10.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the EMC design, filtering and layout, plus successful completion of all applicable UN R10 ESA tests (radiated and conducted emissions, radiated and conducted immunity). Pass if all limits and immunity criteria are met with the lamp in representative normal operating modes (rear position, stop and reversing functions on).

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for radiated emissions.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 7 (broadband) and Annex 8 (narrowband) ESA radiated emission methods, with each lamp function energised at nominal supply. Pass if the emissions stay below the ESA reference limits of R10 paragraphs 6.5 and 6.6.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: UN R10 Annex 9 ESA radiated immunity methods at the field strengths of R10 paragraph 6.7, with functions monitored per the test plan. Pass if there is no degradation of the stop, rear position or reversing lamp functions, e.g. no unintended switching, flicker or loss of light output beyond the defined criteria.

requirements.text: On the rear combination lamp ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband results across 30-1,000 MHz for each operating lamp function with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if every measured value is below the limit (no margin exceedance).

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the positive transient pulse amplitude conducted by the rear combination lamp onto the supply lines shall not exceed +75 V.
requirements.test_case: Perform the ISO 7637-2 test per Annex 10 with a 12 V supply. Pass if the measured maximum positive pulse amplitude is ≤ +75 V.

requirements.text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation of the immunity related functions at 60 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

requirements.text: When tested by the stripline method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 stripline, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation of the immunity related functions at 50 V/m at all frequencies.

requirements.text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 BCI on the harness, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 60 mA over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

requirements.text: When tested by the bulk current injection (BCI) method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 BCI, 20 to 400 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 50 mA at all frequencies.

requirements.text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a test level of 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 21 V/m over at least 90 % of the test frequencies.

requirements.text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method of Annex 9, the ESA shall withstand a minimum test level of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber, LUF to 2,000 MHz. Pass if there is no degradation at 18 V/m at all frequencies.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity related functions of the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Annex 9 at the Table 2a/2b levels. Monitor each lamp function for unintended switching on or off, flicker and loss of light output. Pass if no deviation from normal operation is observed.

requirements.text: If the ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the ESA shall withstand the starting profile at immunity test level II (12 V and 24 V systems) with 10 pulses, achieving functional status B for immunity related functions where the ESA shall be operational during engine start phases, status C for other ESA, and status D for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses, lamps operating; pass if functional status per ISO 16750-1 is B (operational during start) or C (other) for immunity related functions, D for non-related functions.

requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V system) / -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related and not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 2a at +37 V (12 V system) / +37 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC I (immunity related lamp functions, e.g. stop and position lamps) or FPSC III (non-related functions) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V system) / -150 V (24 V system) for a test duration of 1 h with FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V), 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) or FPSC III (non-related) per ISO 7637-1.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8 (narrowband radiated emissions).
requirements.test_case: Design review of the PCB schematic and BOM: confirm absence of any oscillator, clock or switching regulator operating above 9 kHz. If confirmed, the narrowband emission test per Annex 8 may be waived; otherwise test per paragraph 6.6.2./Annex 8.

requirements.text: Where the rear combination lamp ESA is not switched, contains no switches and does not include inductive load, it need not be tested for transient conducted emission on 12/24 V supply lines and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Design review of the circuit: confirm no internal switches, no switching function and no inductive loads (e.g. coils, relays). If confirmed, the transient conducted emission test is waived; otherwise test per paragraph 6.7./Annex 10 on 12/24 V supply lines.

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. (method of Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, where F is the frequency in MHz.
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission test per Annex 7 (ALSE, antenna at 1 m), lamp operated in its emitting modes, 120 kHz measurement bandwidth, scan 30-75 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (62 dBµV/m at 30 MHz falling to 52 dBµV/m at 75 MHz).

requirements.text: When measured according to paragraph 6.5.2.1. (method of Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth, the broadband electromagnetic radiation emitted by the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the constant limit E = 63 dBµV/m.
requirements.test_case: Broadband radiated emission test per Annex 7 (ALSE, antenna at 1 m), lamp operated in its emitting modes, 120 kHz measurement bandwidth, scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all measured values are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband radiated emission limit of the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m, F in MHz, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test with 120 kHz bandwidth, ESA operated in all lamp functions; pass if the measured narrowband level at every frequency from 30 to 75 MHz is at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.), the narrowband radiated emission limit of the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 ESA narrowband radiated emission test with 120 kHz bandwidth, ESA operated in all lamp functions; pass if the measured narrowband level at every frequency from 400 to 1,000 MHz is at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 para 2.1: operate all lamp functions simultaneously at nominal supply voltage (maximum load); verify the operating state is recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: The broadband radiated emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
requirements.test_case: Sweep 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all readings are below the para 6.5 limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: During the narrowband emission test, the rear combination lamp (ESA) under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Annex 8 para. 2; operate the lamp with the functions energised at nominal supply, preferably all functions on (maximum load); check that the test report records the operating mode.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply to the rear combination lamp throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
requirements.test_case: Scan 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions are below paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits across the whole range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements of the rear combination lamp shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Verify measuring instrument detector setting is average for all readings.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the rear combination lamp ESA immunity test shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report references ISO 11452-1 for the frequency range and general conditions.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the rear combination lamp ESA immunity test shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Audit the test setup (temperature, supply voltage, ground plane and similar conditions) against ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: Immunity measurements of the rear combination lamp ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Sweep 20 to 6,000 MHz using ISO 11452-1 steps; no malfunction of the lamp functions is permitted.

requirements.text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation) with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings: AM, 1 kHz, 80 per cent depth over 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2) with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM, Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3) with Ton 500 µs and period 1,000 µs.
requirements.test_case: Verify the generator settings: PM, Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: As an alternative, the ESA may be tested installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 using the BCI substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: If tested in-vehicle, verify ISO 11451-4 substitution method with the probe at 150 mm from the lamp.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 method: apply ISO 7637-2 test pulses and ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines; the functional status of the lamp functions shall meet the ESA immunity criteria.

requirements.text: Conducted transients emitted by the rear combination lamp ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited.
requirements.test_case: Annex 10 paragraph 3 method: measure per ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines; emissions shall stay within the applicable limits.

requirements.text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the 12/24 V supply lines of the ESA, as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: ISO 7637-2: apply pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to each supply line and each connection operationally linked to supply lines; check the lamp functions against the immunity functional status criteria.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Drawing review and visual inspection of a production sample: a marking area is provided that accommodates the approval marking and all markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: 4–6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present and located close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4. (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp).
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: function symbols per paragraph 3.2.4. for each approved function are present.

requirements.text: If the lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, it shall bear a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Review of handedness of lamp design; visual inspection: horizontal arrow present on left- and right-hand variants.

requirements.text: For the rear position lamp, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of lamp in mounted orientation: arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal mounting arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: If reversing lamp approved with reduced light distribution: visual inspection that arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: If applicable per approval: visual inspection that "D" is to the right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: If the lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: If applicable per approval: visual inspection that "Y" is to the right of the relevant function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: If reduced light distribution per Annex 3 paragraph 1.1. is claimed: visual inspection that the downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment is present.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of production sample: approval marking present.

requirements.text: The lamp shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: trade name or mark of applicant present on the lamp.

requirements.text: Since the lamp has non-replaceable light sources (LEDs), the lamp shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range marked on the lamp, consistent with approval documents.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Design review and inspection: marking is on a part permanently joined to the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of lamp fitted on vehicle (boot lid/tailgate opened if necessary): approval marking visible.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: If applicable: inspection that each main body carries only the marking for its own functions.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings of paragraphs 3.3.3.2. and 3.3.3.4. (trade name or mark and rated voltage) shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection: approval marking, trade name/mark and rated voltage are affixed on the lamp itself.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is used for the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, it shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection on vehicle: single approval mark visible after installation.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is used for the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Design review and disassembly check: no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure mark components and compare with minimum sizes of each applicable regulation (e.g. R148, R150): no component smaller than the smallest required minimum.

requirements.text: Each lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Compliance review against all requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. of UN R148 (general and photometric/colorimetric requirements). Pass if every applicable requirement of paragraphs 4. and 5. is fulfilled for each lamp function.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp function shall comply with the requirements of sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and the Annexes referenced in those sections) of UN Regulation No. 48, in the series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, that are pertinent to rear position lamps on M1 vehicles, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review of lamp design and documentation against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 (e.g. geometric visibility angles, orientation) for M1, evaluated during lamp type approval; pass if all requirements verifiable at lamp level are met.

requirements.text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp function, only one manufacturer logo, built by transparent or non-transparent components, shall be incorporated, and all requirements for that specific function of this Regulation shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection for the number of logos within the apparent surface, plus the full photometric and colorimetric tests of the function with the logo present; pass if there is at most one logo and all function requirements are met.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., any logo incorporated in the lamp shall be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo design and check it against the applicant statement (paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)); pass if the logo is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo only.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a rear position lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution in Annex 3, with the maximum intensities not exceeded when all light sources are illuminated, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure as indicated in paragraph 6.10.8. of UN Regulation No. 48 shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement per Annex 3 with each single light source (group) failed in turn: all Annex 3 minimum values met; with all light sources lit: no maximum exceeded. Alternatively, simulate each single failure and verify the failure signal for the tell-tale is produced at the connector. Pass: one of the two options fulfilled for every single failure.

requirements.text: If the failure provision is met by producing a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, the lamp shall only be used on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Check that, where option (b) is used, the communication form note is present and the vehicle electrical architecture includes the failure tell-tale; verify tell-tale activation on vehicle by simulating a single light source failure. Pass: tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, in case of failure of the variable intensity control the requirements of steady luminous intensity of category R2 shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (open/short of control input, controller fault) and measure photometry per Annex 3. Pass: steady luminous intensity requirements of category R2 met automatically without intervention.

requirements.text: The light signalling device shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC assessment at vehicle-type level (e.g. UN R10 radiated and conducted emission tests) with all lamp functions operated. Pass if emissions are within limits and no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems is observed.

requirements.text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall only be removable with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt to remove the module by hand without tools. Pass if removal is only possible with tool(s).

requirements.text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall be tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the module design (sealing, non-dismountable construction). Pass if the module cannot be opened or modified without visible damage.

requirements.text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall, regardless of the use of tool(s), not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit replaceable UN approved light sources into the module seat, and the module into lamp holders, with and without tools. Pass if no interchange is possible.

requirements.text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), the light source module shall, regardless of the use of tool(s), not be interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different functions or characteristics between their seats in the same housing, with and without tools. Pass if no swap is possible.

requirements.text: If the lamp uses replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code, then repeat the photometric measurements per UN R148. Pass if all photometric requirements are met.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure voltage at lamp connector during photometry; pass if 13.5 V for 12 V systems (6.75 V / 28 V for 6 V / 24 V systems).

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate lamp at applicant-specified supply conditions during photometry; pass if conditions match specification.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Annex 3/Annex 8 photometry at HV on both samples; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan over visible directions on both samples; pass if no value exceeds paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: Outside the reference axis, the intensity of the stop lamp shall be not less than the product of the minimum specified in paragraph 5 by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure in Annex 3 for each direction, or not less than the intensity value specified in that figure for each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if every point meets its percentage/value.

requirements.text: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, the intensity of the stop lamp shall be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the stop lamp function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure across Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if ≥ paragraph 5 minimum everywhere.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed for each lamp function.
requirements.test_case: Where visual examination shows local intensity variations, check per Annex 3 local variation criteria; pass if criteria met.

requirements.text: If the applicant requests the additional test to verify visibility of red light towards the front, the maximum intensity of the red lamp functions in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10-1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity over 165°–180° outboard H, -2.5° to +5° V, optionally with vehicle body influence; pass if max ≤ 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities in ±5° V × ±10° H field with stop+position lit and with position lit alone; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: If one or both of the reciprocally incorporated rear position and stop lamps contain more than one light source and are considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered for the 5:1 ratio shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Perform ratio measurement with all LED sources of each function energised; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed for the light emitted by each lamp function.
requirements.test_case: Visual/colorimetric examination outside the Annex 3 grid field with the lamp lit; pass if no sharp variation of colour is observed.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric check per relevant subparagraphs of 4.8 with the lamp's own LED modules installed and energised; colour within prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if every Table 4 value is met by each sample.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 4∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (a); pass if intensity ≥ 4 cd.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 1.7∙10^1 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if intensity ≤ 17 cd in all directions.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady) and marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall not exceed 8.5∙10^0 cd.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per Par. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if intensity ≤ 8.5 cd in all directions.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its standard light distribution (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)) shall comply with Figure A3-I and Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure at grid points of Figure A3-I per Par. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if values per Table A2-1 are met.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category R1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) shall be 5∙10^-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure across the geometric visibility field per Par. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if intensity ≥ 0.05 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement below -5° vertical; pass if intensity ≤ 60 cd there, and Table 4 maxima met elsewhere.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement on both samples per para. 4.8.3.1; pass if every Table 7 value for the declared category (S1 or S2) is met.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady), its minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (a) on both samples; pass if intensity is ≥ 60 cd where required.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 2.60∙10^2 cd (260 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 260 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1 (steady) and marked "D" (para. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 1.30∙10^2 cd (130 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 130 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1, its standard light distribution shall conform to Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measurement at grid points of Figure A3-I per para. 4.8.3.1 (c); pass if each point meets the required percentage of minimum intensity.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S1, the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be at least 3∙10^-1 cd (0.3 cd).
requirements.test_case: Measurement across geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1 per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if ≥ 0.3 cd throughout.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and used as a single lamp, its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 7.30∙10^2 cd (730 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 730 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2 (variable) and marked "D" (para. 3.3.2.5.2.), its maximum luminous intensity shall not exceed 3.65∙10^2 cd (365 cd).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement per para. 4.8.3.1 (b); pass if no measured intensity exceeds 365 cd.

requirements.text: If the stop lamp is of category S2, the luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be at least 7∙10^-2 cd (0.07 cd) in night condition.
requirements.test_case: Measurement across geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1 in night mode per para. 4.8.3.1 (d); pass if ≥ 0.07 cd throughout.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light through the outer lens; pass if chromaticity coordinates lie within the red boundaries defined in the regulation.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp (category AR) supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of both samples per paragraph 4.8.3.1; pass if all Table 10 values (minimum, maximum, standard light distribution Figure A3-V) are met by each sample.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall emit a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (a)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at the reference axis/test points of the standard light distribution; pass if intensity ≥ 80 cd.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 3.00∙10^2 cd in or above the H-plane (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan in and above the H-plane; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 300 cd.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 6.00∙10^2 cd below the H-plane, down to 5°D (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan from H-plane down to 5°D; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 600 cd.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity of the reversing lamp of category AR shall not exceed 8.00∙10^3 cd below 5°D (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (b)).
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan below 5°D; pass if maximum intensity ≤ 8000 cd.

requirements.text: The light distribution of the reversing lamp of category AR shall comply with the standard light distribution defined in Figure A3-V (paragraph 4.8.3.1. (c)).
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at all Figure A3-V grid points; pass if each value meets the percentage of the minimum specified in Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: If the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied up to an angle of 30° inwards, where the photometric intensity is verified only up to that angle.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement inward up to 30°; pass if intensity ≥ 25 cd; condition declared in approval documents (paragraph 3.1.).

requirements.text: If type approval is granted under the pair-only condition, the reversing lamp shall only be installed on the vehicle in a pair.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection; pass if two reversing lamps are fitted as a pair, consistent with item 9.1.3 of the communication form.

requirements.text: For conformity of production of the rear combination lamp, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in UN R148.
requirements.test_case: Photometric/colorimetric measurement of production samples per Annexes 4 and 5; pass if every measured value is within 20 per cent unfavourable deviation of the prescribed value.

requirements.text: For a required minimum value of 7∙10-1 cd throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured value of the rear combination lamp shall correspond to 5∙10-1 cd (equivalent 20 per cent) and 3∙10-1 cd (equivalent 30 per cent) as shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of production samples across the Annex 2/3 fields; pass if points requiring 7∙10-1 cd measure at least 5∙10-1 cd (20 per cent level) or 3∙10-1 cd (30 per cent level) as applicable per Annex 5.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of Annex 2 apply as shown to lamps mounted on the right side of the vehicle; for the lamp mounted on the left side of the vehicle the same angles shall be applied mirrored (inboard/outboard interchanged).
requirements.test_case: Drawing/CAD review of the left and right lamps: confirm the inboard/outboard visibility angles are mirrored correctly for each side. Pass if each side meets the Table A2-1 values in its own inboard/outboard sense.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of the apparent surface on a goniometer or CAD sight-line analysis, lamp installed per vehicle drawing. Pass if the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inboard to 80° outboard.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, the reduced minimum horizontal angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the H-plane mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify by goniometer or CAD that visibility is at least 45°/80° above the H-plane and at least 20°/80° below it.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above and 15° below the H-plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer or CAD sight-line check of the apparent surface, lamp installed. Pass if the surface is unobstructed from 15° up to 15° down.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp (R1, R2) is installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, the minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and 5° below.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height. If below 750 mm, verify visibility from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if unobstructed.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is of category MR and singular, it shall have minimum horizontal angles of 80° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 45° outboard.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer or CAD sight-line check of the apparent surface, lamp installed. Pass if unobstructed from 45° inboard to 45° outboard.

requirements.text: If the stop lamps are of category MS and installed as a pair, each lamp shall have minimum horizontal angles of 0° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15° above / 5° below for an H-plane mounting height of less than 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: Goniometer or CAD visibility check against these angles. Pass if all are met.

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values of the standard light distribution figures giving the minimum intensities for the various directions of measurement as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Photometric goniometer measurement about the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°) through the centre of reference. Compute each grid-point minimum as the Figure A3-I percentage × the required minimum intensity, rounded down to three significant digits. Pass if every measured value ≥ its computed minimum.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution shown as a grid, the light intensity of the rear position lamp in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown, as a percentage, on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer scan between the grid points of Figure A3-I. Pass if every intermediate direction ≥ the lowest minimum percentage of the surrounding grid lines × the required minimum intensity.

requirements.text: When visual examination of a reversing lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement shall be below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the lit reversing lamp. If local variations are seen, scan intensity between adjacent Figure A3-V measuring points. Pass if each intermediate value ≥ 50 % of the lower prescribed minimum of the two adjacent points.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given in Figure A3-I as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 3).
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement at all Figure A3-I measuring points. Pass if each point ≥ its percentage × the Table 3 minimum intensity.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 or S2 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities given in Figure A3-I as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Table 7).
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement at all Figure A3-I measuring points. Pass if each point ≥ its percentage × the Table 7 minimum intensity.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, any rear combination lamp chosen at random from mass production shall meet the photometric requirements when tested according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of a randomly selected production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if conformity is not contestable under that paragraph.
